name: Schema Diff
description: Shows a detailed diff between the declared and installed database schema.
project_description:
Developer only 
 This module is intended to be used by developers to help debug Mismatched entity and/or field definitions errors in their status report.

 It should not be used in production

 
 This is a utility module that allows to view the schema difference on /admin/reports/status page.

 Features 
 - Whenever there are any mis-matched entity field definitions, those are visible on "admin/reports/status" page. Currently, Drupal core doesn't provide any way to view what is the difference between defined storage schema and installed storage schema.

- This module allows to view the difference for each field in tabular format.

 Post-Installation 
 - Visit the "admin/reports/status" page after installing the module.

- Visit entity field mismatch error section.
